title: Kinetic Wedge Layers and Diffusive Limit of Neutron Transport in Polygonal Domains
summary: We study the diffusive limit of the steady neutron transport equation with velocity-dependent in-flow boundary data in polygonal domains. On a bounded convex polygon, we construct an approximation by the interior solution, flat side layers, and wedge layers, and prove an algebraic error estimate in $L^\infty$. We also give a complete formulation and well-posedness theory for the kinetic wedge layer, including its algebraic decay.
